Definition: properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) detest
BiblicalUsage: They shall remember me among the nations, says the LORD, and they shall loathe themselves for the evils they have committed in all their abominations. Twice Ezekiel carries the word: you shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe loathing yourself for your evils is the beginning of return, because God breaks the heart that remembers.
